issues.description: The ktest TestPtConfig implementation omits two required PageTableConfig proof methods, leaving the trait implementation incomplete when checked with proof members retained.
issues.rationale: `PageTableConfig` adds `lemma_top_level_index_range_bounds` and `lemma_leading_bits_only_when_high_half` as required trait methods with no default bodies. The `#[cfg(ktest)]` module's `TestPtConfig` implementation defines its constants, associated types, and item conversion methods but implements neither new proof method. When the ktest configuration is checked with Verus proof members retained, the trait implementation is incomplete. These members are proof functions inside verus!, so this source finding does not establish failure of an ordinary Rust build after ghost/proof erasure. The review comment was AI-assisted, so it was treated only as a lead; the missing required members and failure condition were independently confirmed from the fixed final source, where the issue remains.
issues.verification: source-only; the historical ktest target was not compiled. Independently inspected the final trait declaration and cfg(ktest) implementation and confirmed that both required, non-default methods are absent. The remote thread remains current rather than outdated. Follow-up source review scoped the missing-method claim to proof-retaining checking; neither a ktest build nor a ghost-erased Rust build was executed in this sweep.

issues.description: Two new page-table proof bodies import arithmetic helpers that are never referenced in their function scopes.
issues.rationale: Both `lemma_top_level_index_range_bounds` bodies import `nr_subpage_per_huge`, `nr_pte_index_bits`, `pte_index_bit_offset_spec`, and `pow2`, but their remaining statements use none of those names. Because the imports are function-scoped, uses in the separate `lemma_leading_bits_only_when_high_half` body do not make them live. The duplicate unused imports add proof noise and remain in the final head. The same-head AGENTS.md requires routine proof edits to stay lightweight and all edits to be minimal and localized.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus and warning-as-error builds were not executed. The AI-assisted comments were used only as leads. Independently checked each function scope in the final source and the same-head minimal-edit rule; the imports remain unused in both selected locations.
